description: API and frontend engineers need to know whether a JSON schema change will break real payloads, generated clients, or form bindings before they ship it.

new_json_schema.description: Must be valid JSON text representing the proposed schema version. The schema must parse as an object; if parsing fails, show a parse error and stop comparison.

old_json_schema.description: Must be valid JSON text representing the previous schema version. The schema must parse as an object; if parsing fails, show a parse error and stop comparison.

sample_payloads.description: Optional JSON text. Accept a single JSON value, an array of JSON values, or newline-separated JSON values. Blank input means no sample payload analysis.

show_path_details.description: Boolean toggle. When true, path-level findings must include explicit JSON Pointer style paths and short evidence notes.

strict_mode.description: Boolean toggle. When true, treat any added required constraint, narrowed type, removed enum option, reduced allowed array/object shape, or newly forbidden property as breaking.

name: json-schema-drift-impact-checker
title: JSON Schema Drift Impact Checker
